grantGate: Manager runtime grants are wired only after automated smoke passes for content verify, strict Phase 20 verify, P2 source fill readback, exact-stage gates, route-entry verification, reward SPEL/MGEF readback, and remain pending runtime/manual proof for Active Effects display, save/load, Survey clarity, and balance feel.
grantOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest dawn/state logic after record readback
globalStackRule: One first-tier race reward active per player origin lane; suppress duplicate grants; remove stale first-tier race reward before adding another; never stack with a higher tier of the same race lane.
dialogueBoundary: V1 remains non-voiced. Reward text may surface through spell/effect descriptions, Survey/status, notifications, message boxes, MCM, books/notes, shrine/service gates, or Prisma after separate UI proof.

races.lane: Auri-El/Xarxes/Magnus baseline under Lorkhan crisis pressure
races.playerFacingText: Your discipline steadies the old Altmeri path without hiding the cost of the Dragonborn crisis.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Altmer_Orthodox_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.
races.grantRemovalOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest dawn consolidation only after smoke; no event-time grant.
races.stackCapRule: Suppress while Altmer curse/crisis penalty effect is active unless manager explicitly resolves precedence.
races.daedricInteraction: Daedric champion effects outrank this T1 steadiness unless the Altmer path is explicitly reconciled.
races.notes: Magnitude provisional; prefer steadiness/discipline over broad magicka scaling.

races.playerFacingText: The Hist path keeps you steady when you act for memory, people, and survival.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Argonian_Hist_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.
races.grantRemovalOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest dawn/state logic after Hist posture smoke.
races.stackCapRule: Do not stack with Sithis-only edge rewards; manager chooses the active Argonian lane.
races.daedricInteraction: Sithis and Daedric pressure may annotate or suppress the Hist reward, but should not silently double-stack it.
races.notes: Keep effect defensive/survival-facing, not a generic poison or disease bundle unless balance review approves it.

races.lane: Y'ffre living story and exchange parity
races.playerFacingText: The living story answers when pact, exchange, and road wisdom remain in balance.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Bosmer_Yffre_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.

races.stackCapRule: Only one Bosmer path reward active; suppress when Baan Dar or Z'en lane is selected.
races.daedricInteraction: Hircine hunt pressure is an edge, not a free stack with Y'ffre T1.
races.notes: Avoid generic archery-only reward; needs path/playstyle breadth.

races.lane: Knightly vow, hidden art, and Green Way tradition choice
races.playerFacingText: Your chosen Breton tradition holds shape through vow, hidden art, or the green road.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.
races.grantRemovalOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest Breton tradition state at dawn after smoke.
races.stackCapRule: Only the current Breton tradition T1 may be active; remove stale tradition effects on state change.
races.daedricInteraction: Daedric occult pressure may explain hidden-art tension but must not auto-upgrade this reward.
races.notes: Keep broad enough for knight/mage/nature play without rewarding generic spell spam.

races.playerFacingText: The Reclamations answer a disciplined path; deviation still carries a price.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Dunmer_Reclamation_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.
races.grantRemovalOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest Dunmer focus state at dawn after smoke.
races.stackCapRule: Only one Reclamation focus reward active; deviation price suppresses the matching T1 when unresolved.
races.daedricInteraction: Azura, Boethiah, and Mephala lanes remain distinct from generic Daedric champion effects.
races.notes: Avoid flattening Azura/Boethiah/Mephala into one generic Daedra reward in final tuning.

races.lane: Civic service, lawful patronage, and private/public Talos pressure
races.playerFacingText: Civic duty lends order to your worship, even where public and private loyalties diverge.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: SPEL PDV_Bless_Imperial_Civic_T1 exists, carries one MGEF, and the MGEF description is ASCII-safe.
races.grantRemovalOwner: PDV__ManagerQuest Imperial civic state at dawn after smoke.
races.stackCapRule: Do not stack civic T1 with an unresolved Talos-pressure penalty or private-Talos privilege.
races.daedricInteraction: Daedric patron rewards should suppress civic T1 only when manager state declares public rupture.
races.notes: Civil War oath validators remain review-gated until branch evidence is stronger.

races.playerFacingText: The moons have noticed how you move. At night, your stamina regenerates 5% faster and your resistance to disease rises by 10%.
races.recordReadbackAssertion: Pilot-provisional SPEL PDV_Bless_Khajiit_Lunar_T1 exists, carries night-gated stamina/disease MGEFs, preserves CAT-6 source text, and is manager-wired through the all-race reward contract.

races.daedricInteraction: Azurah focus and Daedric champion effects are explicit overlays, not silent additions.
races.notes: Current CAT-6 pilot record is preserved as the Khajiit T1 reward packet; broad grant behavior is now owned by the all-race reward contract, not by the standalone CAT-6 pilot.

races.lane: Old ways, Kyne/Talos context, and Hircine/Arkay edge
races.playerFacingText: The old ways steady a Nord who keeps voice, kin, and hard choices in view.

races.notes: Avoid narrow warrior-only reward; support labor/duty/survival alongside combat.

races.playerFacingText: The ancestor spine steadies your sect path without making every compromise clean.
